indexed_or_summarized_context: Adjacent microsequences lesson and authorized tree

write_scope: All cards and internal order of current microsequence
indexed_or_summarized_context: Adjacent microsequences lesson and authorized tree

write_scope: Selected microsequences including their internal cards

write_scope: All microsequences and their order inside current lesson
